annotations.title: Trial balance of a DIYA-GL book

description: Answers the trial balance of the open DIYA-GL book of a company: every account's balance in the debit or the credit column and the two totals, over the year, one month, one VAT quarter or a date range, with the year-end postings of the registers. Name an account to also get the lines and postings behind its balance. Use this when the person asks whether their trial balance balances, what an account's balance is, or what moved in a month. Company DIYA-GL books only. It does not change the book or contact HMRC.

account.description: An account id (for example 1300); adds that account's postings

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, for a custom range

month.description: YYYY-MM of the month, or of the VAT quarter's last month; needed for month and vatQuarter

period.description: year (the default), month, vatQuarter, or custom with from and to

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, for a custom range
